agent_behaviors.description: Digitize, review, organize and export books.
Search reviewed editions and cite exact source passages.

entries.description: Start a structured-book run from one file or an explicitly ordered list in a folder. Use a fresh run_id.

Export a reviewed UTF-8 manuscript file through the EPUB node. Manuscript JSON: {identifier,title,author,language,modified,chapters:[{title,paragraphs:[text]}]}. modified is a UTC timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ; paragraphs are literal text, not HTML. path is its folder, manuscript its simple file name, output a new .epub file name. The node records ShelfEdition after writing the artifact. Text editions only.

Build a polished EPUB and matching citable passages from a validated structured-book.json snapshot. run_id is a new edition ID. path is its writable edition folder; structured is a simple JSON filename. modified is UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ; output is a new EPUB filename. This invokes native cleanup, bounded agent polish, strict edit application, and complete-edition assembly.

Submit exact local edits as edits_json, a JSON array of {block_id,old_text,new_text,reason}. Submit at most 50 edits; combine neighboring corrections in the same block into one exact source quote when needed. Each old_text must occur exactly once in that block. Limit each old_text to 1200 bytes and new_text to 2400 bytes. For source-confirmed non-text OCR only, replace the complete block quote with an empty new_text and include non_text_ocr_page (physical scan page). First inspect that page with load_page_image in this attempt. Do not use this for genuine text or uncertain OCR. Use [] when no correction is supported. Scope and chunk identity are filled by the host.

Open an exact citation using book_id, edition_id and passage_id from a search hit. To find citations first, call query with {"argv":["search"],"collection":"ShelfLibraryPassage","options":{"fields":["book_id","edition_id","passage_id","preview","locator_summary","status"],"search_fields":["text"],"text":"search terms","filter":{"access":{"_eq":"open"},"edition_id":{"_in":["selected edition ID"]},"_alias":{"_score":{"_gt":0}}},"limit":5}}. Select edition IDs from ShelfLibraryEdition first. _score is returned automatically: never include _score or _alias in fields. Use query field recovery when opened text is truncated.
